description: A comprehensive security scanning script for LiteLLM, including installation of tools (Trivy, Grype, ggshield), running security scans on codebases, Docker images, and handling vulnerability reports with allowlists.

methods.name: install_trivy
methods.description: Installs Trivy and required tools for vulnerability scanning.

methods.name: run_secret_detection
methods.description: Runs secret detection scans using ggshield, requiring GITGUARDIAN_API_KEY.

methods.name: run_trivy_scans
methods.description: Performs filesystem vulnerability scans on specified directories.

methods.name: run_grype_scans
methods.description: Builds Docker images and scans them for vulnerabilities, including local image analysis with allowlist handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution flow that installs tools and runs all security scans.
